content.summary: The price of  Bitcoin  was sliding early Thursday, as a miserable month so far for crypto investors went from bad to worse.  The world’s largest cryptocurrency slipped 2.2% to $110,558 over the past 24 hours, according to data from CoinDesk.  Among other tokens,  Ethereum  fell 3.6%,  Solana  dropped 6.5%, and  XRP  slid 5% over the past 24 hours, according to data from the crypto exchange Kraken.
